theater: 四川瀘州江陽府東神臂城

battle.name: 瀘州之戰
battle.theater: 四川瀘州江陽府東神臂城
battle.brief: 德祐二年(1276)六月,四川制置使張珏率義士奇襲西川行院治所,殺元將熊耳;十月元軍撤圍重慶轉攻瀘州,於合江紅米灣、安樂山擊敗宋軍;景炎二年(1277)十一月總攻,破寶子寨、盤山寨與神臂門,瀘州淪陷。卡面十字弩即宋軍城頭神臂弓弩,裝填遲緩而命中穩定,撐住一年有餘,終敗於糧盡援絕。

kit.name: 十字弩
kit.history: 弩把射速交給了機械，代價是裝填慢。城牆上它比長弓可靠，野戰裡它比長弓脆弱。

countries: 交戰雙方是元朝的西川行院軍與南宋四川制置司系統下的川軍、寨軍與瀘州守軍。元方以至元十三年（1276）設於四川的西川行院為節制中樞：行院治所一度設在瀘州城內，總攝攻蜀諸軍，兵種由蒙古騎兵、漢軍降卒（宋地歸附的步卒與攻城匠）、江河水師（以橋船水手軍為骨幹）以及攜帶配重砲、雲梯的攻城部隊拼成，糧食、器械與兵員多自長江下游水運而來，軍令由同簽行樞密院事、萬戶、千戶逐級分派。宋方則是南宋最後的西南防區：四川制置司與各府安撫司並立，張珏以制置使總領重慶、合州一線的山城防務，瀘州以安撫王世昌為長、守將劉雄與李都統分掌城兵，外圍再由義士劉霖、先坤朋與宋將史忠訓、趙安、任慶等部眾組成寨堡與水軍。編制上，宋軍以合州釣魚城那樣的山城為骨幹，外圍有寶子寨、盤山寨、珍珠堡等寨堡，瀘州本身又分為江岸旱城與江心水城，兩者以橋相連，構成多層拒止；元軍則以野戰騎兵封鎖江面、以水師控制渡口、以攻城序列拔除外圍據點，最後才合圍攻城。雙方爭的不是一城一地，而是長江上游的鹽、糧與節制權：瀘州井鹽是四川軍費的主要來源之一，佔據瀘州即等於握住南宋在川南的錢袋子。
countriesEn: The two sides were the Western River Military Government (xichuan xingyuan) army of the Yuan dynasty and the Song army, garrison militia and townspeople of Luzhou under the Southern Song's Sichuan administrative system. On the Yuan side the coordinating hub was the Western River Military Government established in Sichuan in 1276, the thirteenth year of the Zhiyuan era: its headquarters stood for a time inside Luzhou itself and it directed all the armies operating against Sichuan. Its troops were pieced together from Mongol cavalry, Han Chinese troops who had surrendered from the Song (foot soldiers and siege engineers), river and lake flotillas whose backbone was the Bridge-Boat Watermen Command, and assault detachments carrying counterweight trebuchets and siege ladders. Food, equipment and replacements came up the Yangtze by water, and orders were passed down step by step from the Assistant Commissioner of the Privy Council to the commanders of ten thousand men and of a thousand. On the Song side lay the last southwestern defensive region of the Southern Song: the Sichuan Military Commission sat alongside the pacification commissions of the various prefectures. Zhang Jue, as Military Commissioner, directed the mountain fortresses of Chongqing and Hezhou; in Luzhou the pacification commissioner Wang Shichang was in overall charge, with the commanders Liu Xiong and Li Dutong holding the city troops, while the outer ring was manned by the local volunteers Liu Lin and Xian Kunpeng and by Song officers such as Shi Zhongxun, Zhao An and Ren Qing. Structurally the Song army was built around mountain fortresses of the Hezhou Diaoyucheng type, ringed by stockades such as Baozhai, Panshanzhai and Zhenzhupu; Luzhou itself was split into a land city on the bank and a water city out in the river, the two joined by a bridge, forming a refusal in several layers. The Yuan, by contrast, sealed the river with field cavalry, held the crossings with river troops, stripped the outer posts with a siege train, and only then closed in for the final assault. What both sides were after was not merely a city but the salt, the grain and the command: the salt wells of Luzhou were one of the main sources of Sichuan's war revenue, and to hold Luzhou was to hold the purse of southern Sichuan.
people: 留下姓名的以元將為多，但真正決定這場戰役走勢的是宋方的四川制置使張珏。德祐二年（1276）六月，張珏率軍配合瀘州義士劉霖、先坤朋奇襲元軍西川行院治所，殺元朝守將熊耳與安撫梅應春，俘虜元將眷屬，此舉意在解重慶之圍，也是整場戰役中宋方唯一的主動出擊。十月元軍撤圍重慶轉攻瀘州，宋將史忠訓、趙安奉張珏之命率援軍東下，途中被元萬戶拜延阻擊，百餘人被俘，救援無果。瀘州方面的骨幹是安撫王世昌與守將劉雄、李都統：城破時王世昌與李都統戰歿，劉雄被俘，外圍各寨的守將如任慶則在盤山寨失守時被擒。元軍方面的名單則是各路攻城將領——同簽行樞密院事劉思敬最為關鍵，他負責攻盤山寨，總攻之夜又率軍夜襲破東門而入，巷戰之後引元軍奪取城內地盤；管軍千戶步魯合答造雲梯登城，先拔寶子寨；劉整之子劉垓與萬戶拜延攻打神臂山上的珍珠堡，拜延並在途中擋下宋軍援兵；橋船水手軍總管石抹不老攻神臂門，一度衝上城樓又被宋軍擊退；管軍萬戶秃滿答兒、札剌不花夜奪水城，萬戶也罕的斤與石抹不老在天亮後先克神臂門。此外，還有元將且只兒在合江紅米灣與安樂山一線連敗宋軍，斬首五百餘級、奪戰艦四艘，是切斷瀘州外援的關鍵人物。背景人物則是已故的降元漢人名將劉整——其子仍在元軍效力，而劉整本人早於1274年病卒。
peopleEn: More names survive on the Yuan side, but the man who really shaped the course of the battle was Zhang Jue, the Southern Song's Military Commissioner for Sichuan. In the sixth month of 1276 Zhang Jue led troops in a night attack on the Yuan's Western River Military Government headquarters at Luzhou, in company with the Luzhou volunteers Liu Lin and Xian Kunpeng; they killed the Yuan garrison commander Xiong'er and the pacification commissioner Mei Yingchun and captured the families of Yuan officers. The blow was aimed at relieving Chongqing, and it was the only proactive stroke the Song managed in the whole campaign. In the tenth month the Yuan withdrew from Chongqing and turned against Luzhou, and the Song officers Shi Zhongxun and Zhao An, sent down from Chongqing by Zhang Jue with a relief force, were intercepted on the road by the Yuan commander of ten thousand men, Bayan, who took more than a hundred prisoners; no help arrived. The backbone of the Luzhou defence was the pacification commissioner Wang Shichang with the commanders Liu Xiong and Li Dutong: Wang Shichang and Li Dutong were killed when the city fell, Liu Xiong was captured, and officers of the outer posts, such as Ren Qing, were taken when Panshanzhai was lost. The Yuan names are a roll of assault commanders, of whom the most consequential was Liu Sijing, Assistant Commissioner of the Privy Council: he was given Panshanzhai, and on the night of the general assault he led a night attack that broke the East Gate and entered the streets, and the storming of the inner city followed his men in. The commander of a thousand men, Buluheda, built the siege ladders, scaled the walls and took Baozhai first; Liu Gai, son of the surrendered Song general Liu Zheng, and Bayan attacked Zhenzhupu on Shenbi Hill, and it was Bayan who cut off Zhang Jue's relief column; the Bridge-Boat Watermen commander Shimo Buliao attacked the Shenbi Gate, at one point reaching the gate tower before being thrown back by the Song; the commanders of ten thousand men, Tumandare and Jalabagha, seized the water city by night, and Yahan Diken and Shimo Buliao led the assault on the Shenbi Gate once day broke. Beyond them there was the Yuan general Jie Zhi'er, who twice beat the Song near Hongmi Bay and Anle Mountain in Hejiang, taking more than five hundred heads and four warships, and who was the man who severed Luzhou's relief. The background figure is the late turncoat of renown, Liu Zheng, whose son was still serving in the Yuan army although Liu Zheng himself had died of illness back in 1274.
kits: 卡面的十字弩在這場戰役中的位置很明確：它是宋軍城頭與寨堡的骨幹火力。宋代弩的形制為木弩臂配鋼弦、鐵機關，強弩（俗稱神臂弓）臂長而拉力大，射程可及百步上下，箭鏃厚，能在城頭壓制江面渡口與坡道上的攀登者；元人記宋軍神臂門上弩手輪番射擊，正是此役中弩最具代表性的畫面。但弩的代價就是裝填慢：上弦、張弦、置矢、擊發耗去的時間遠比拉弓為久，因此弩只適合守城與守寨的定點射擊，一到野戰、追擊與轉進就顯得笨拙，這正是宋代「守城靠弩、野外靠弓」的道理。宋軍其餘裝備包括長弓、霹靂砲與火藥箭、檑木滾石、撞竿破門、拒馬鹿角與陷坑，以及夜襲時使用的藤牌、洞屋與繩索；水城與江面巡邏靠小型舟艇，專門攔截元軍漕舟。元軍的裝備表則更齊：配重投石車、雲梯（步魯合答於總攻時造雲梯登城）、壕溝與穴地、火藥爆物、攻城槌與衝車，以及蒙古彎弓、標槍、馬刀與皮甲札甲；漢軍降卒攜帶的弩亦在列，但元軍用弩多作夜襲與封鎖的近程火力，攻城主力仍靠配重砲與騎兵。此外雙方的後勤差距才是這一場戰役真正的裝備問題：元軍以橋船水手軍與漕舟沿長江逆流運糧，宋軍則靠合州、重慶的山城屯田與井鹽收入維持，瀘州被圍後糧道一斷，城內很快告罄。
kitsEn: The crossbow shown on the card has a clearly defined place in this battle: it was the backbone firepower of the Song on the walls and in the stockades. The crossbow of the Song was a wooden stave with a steel string and an iron trigger mechanism, and the powerful type, popularly called the shenbi bow, had a long stave and great draw weight, reaching to something like a hundred paces, with a thick bolt that could pierce armour; the Yuan records of Song crossbowmen shooting in turn from the Shenbi Gate are the most characteristic image of the crossbow in this campaign. But the price of the crossbow is slow loading: cocking the string, spanning, laying the bolt and releasing takes far longer than drawing a bow, so the crossbow is suited only to fixed fire from a wall or a stockade, and in the open field, in pursuit and on the move it turns clumsy, which is why the Song held that walls rely on the crossbow and the field on the bow. The rest of the Song equipment included longbows, thunder-stone bombs and fire arrows, log pounders and rolling stones, battering rams against the gates, spiked fences with caltrops and pits, and for night attacks rattan shields, mobile galleries and ropes; small boats patrolled the water city and the river, and their business was intercepting the Yuan grain convoys. The Yuan inventory was fuller in some respects: counterweight trebuchets, siege ladders — Buluheda built them for the general assault — trenches and mine galleries, gunpowder explosives, rams and battering gates, together with Mongol wia bows, javelins, sabres and leather and lamellar armour. Crossbows carried by the surrendered Han troops were also present, but on the Yuan side the crossbow was mainly a short-range weapon for night attacks and blockades, the real weight of the siege falling on the trebuchets and the cavalry. The real disparity in equipment in this battle, though, was one of logistics: the Yuan moved grain up the Yangtze in bridge-boats and grain boats, while the Song held out on the fortresses of Hezhou and Chongqing and on the income of the salt wells; once Luzhou was surrounded its grain route was cut, and the city emptied its stores quickly.
tactics: 雙方都採用宋元對抗的標準辦法，但落點不同。元軍先以重兵合圍重慶府，企圖拔掉宋軍在川東的樞紐；六月張珏奇襲行院治所成功後，十月元軍主動撤圍重慶，轉而西向攻擊瀘州，同時以騎兵沿江搜索，於合江紅米灣、安樂山一線擊潰宋軍的攔截部隊，奪取石盤寨的水上寨堡，之後又擊敗專門截擊漕舟的宋軍水師，切斷瀘州與長江下游的直接聯繫。攻城序列中，元軍先取外圍據點：步魯合答打城西北的寶子寨，劉思敬打城東北的盤山寨，劉垓與拜延打神臂山上的珍珠堡，三處寨堡陷落後才合圍攻城。總攻安排在景炎二年（1277）十一月：劉思敬乘宋軍激戰一日、人馬疲憊，率軍夜襲破東門並入城巷戰；秃滿答兒、札剌不花同時夜奪水城；黎明登城入城，天亮後各軍共攻神臂門，由也罕的斤與石抹不老先克。撤退與增援是此役的另一條主線：宋廷與張珏的援軍沿江東下，結果在途中被拜延的騎兵阻斷，瀘州得不到任何外部支援。守方的戰術是多層拒止：外圍寨堡消耗敵軍攻勢，寨堡盡失後退守城樓、門樓與水城，弩手居高射擊，必要時以夜襲反制；元軍的攻城梯隊則始終保持夜裡行動、白天鞏固的節奏，避免在攻城器械展開時被城頭弩手打散。
tacticsEn: Both sides used the standard methods of Song-Yuan warfare, but they landed them differently. The Yuan first invested Chongqing in force, aiming to pull out the hinge of the Song defence in eastern Sichuan; after Zhang Jue's June raid on the military government headquarters succeeded, in the tenth month the Yuan deliberately lifted the siege of Chongqing and turned westward against Luzhou, while cavalry searched along the river, breaking the Song blocking force at Hongmi Bay and Anle Mountain in Hejiang, taking the water stockade of Shipanzhai, and then beating the Song flotilla that had come out to intercept the grain convoys, cutting Luzhou's direct link with the lower river. In the siege sequence the Yuan took the outer posts first: Buluheda against Baozhai on the north-west of the city, Liu Sijing against Panshanzhai on the north-east, Liu Gai and Bayan against Zhenzhupu on Shenbi Hill; only when those three were gone did the army close in. The general assault was set for the eleventh month of 1277: Liu Sijing, taking advantage of the Song troops being exhausted after a hard day's fighting, led a night attack that broke the East Gate and led to street fighting; Tumandare and Jalabagha seized the water city the same night; the troops climbed in at dawn, and once the sun was up all the units turned on the Shenbi Gate, taken first by Yahan Diken and Shimo Buliao. Relief and retreat formed the other main thread: reinforcements from the Song court and from Zhang Jue came down the river and were cut off in mid-route by Bayan's cavalry, so that Luzhou received no outside help at all. The defence was a refusal in layers: the outer stockades wore down the attack, and once these were lost the defenders fell back on the gate towers, the barbicans and the water city, with crossbowmen shooting from above, counterattacking by night when they had to; the Yuan's ladder teams worked at night and consolidated by day, so that their siege machines were never left exposed to the crossbows on the wall while they were being set up.
data: 可核實的數字集中在幾處。時間線：1276年6月張珏奇襲西川行院治所瀘州；同年10月元軍撤圍重慶、轉攻瀘州，途中在合江紅米灣與安樂山交戰；1277年11月總攻破城。圍城自十月起「相峙一年有餘」，其間城中糧盡，這是宋廷在城破之後被記錄的主要敗因。戰果方面，且只兒在安樂山一戰斬首五百餘級、獲戰艦四艘；劉思敬攻破盤山寨時擒獲守將任慶，附帶俘虜九千餘戶；張珏所遣援軍被拜延阻擊，百餘人被俘。這些數字是《續資治通鑑》卷一百八十三一路記下來的，屬當時記帳式的概數，方向可信，個位數不必深究。地理方面，瀘州在長江與沱江交會處，東岸的神臂城與江心水城隔江相望；自瀘州至重慶順江約二百六十公里，舟行五六日可達，至合江約九十公里，正是且只兒攔截援軍的戰場。行政與物資方面，瀘州是四川井鹽重鎮，鹽利是四川軍費的主要支柱之一，故元軍必欲奪之；宋廷這邊，1276年二月臨安出降、襄樊與兩淮已先後失守，蜀中守軍已成孤軍，糧餉全靠本地鹽井與山田。兵員總數在雙方史籍中皆無可靠記載，正史多作「十餘萬」之類的概數，只宜當作量級看待。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked are few and clustered in particular places. The timeline: in June 1276 Zhang Jue raided the Yuan Western River Military Government headquarters at Luzhou; in October of the same year the Yuan lifted the siege of Chongqing and turned on Luzhou, fighting at Hongmi Bay and Anle Mountain in Hejiang on the way; in November 1277 the general assault broke the city. The siege, which began in October, lasted a year and more, and during it the city's grain ran out, which is the principal reason the Song side is recorded to have failed after the fall. As to the results of the fighting, Jie Zhi'er at Anle Mountain took more than five hundred heads and captured four warships; when Liu Sijing took Panshanzhai he seized the defending commander Ren Qing together with more than nine thousand households; and the Song relief force was intercepted by Bayan, with more than a hundred prisoners. These figures come the whole way from the Xu Zizhi Tongjian, juan 183; they are the rough bookkeeping kind of number of the age, reliable in direction, but not to be pressed in their final digits. Geographically, Luzhou stands where the Yangtze meets the Tuo River, with the Shenbi city on the east bank facing the water city out in the river; downstream from Luzhou to Chongqing is about 260 kilometres, five or six days' journey by boat, and to Hejiang about ninety kilometres, which is the ground on which Jie Zhi'er intercepted the relief. In administrative and material terms Luzhou was a major salt centre of Sichuan, and salt revenue was one of the main pillars of Sichuan's war finance, so the Yuan had to have it; on the Song side, with Lin'an surrendered in the second month of 1276 and Xiangfan and the Two Rivers long since lost, the Sichuan army was already an isolated force sustained entirely by local salt wells and hill fields. Reliable overall troop numbers are simply not recorded: the official histories give only round figures of more than a hundred thousand, which can be treated as an order of magnitude and nothing more.
cause: 打起來有四層。第一層是元朝滅宋的總部署：德祐二年（1276）二月伯顏攻入臨安、南宋朝廷出降後，元廷把兵鋒轉向尚未平服的四川，於是西川行院在瀘州設治所、節制攻蜀諸軍，把宋方的重鎮變成自己的指揮所，這直接引來宋方的報復性打擊。第二層是南宋四川的生存困境：襄樊陷落後，荊湖與兩淮的屏障盡失，川南的糧源與援兵通道只剩長江一線，而重慶、合州兩座山城成了南宋最後的據點，張珏必須守住重慶外圍，而元軍治所偏偏就屯在瀘州。第三層是雙方對戰術的主導權爭奪：張珏判斷，與其坐等重慶被圍死，不如先取瀘州行院治所，摧其指揮中樞、奪其鹽利，這樣才有餘裕；六月奇襲得手後，瀘州反而成了元軍的目標。第四層是地形與物資的必然結果：瀘州位於長江與沱江交會處，扼住川南水陸兩路，是宋軍水上巡邏與上游糧船的必經之地，雙方都不可能放過；於是元軍以圍城斷糧代替強攻，把攻城時序拉長到一年有餘。
causeEn: There were four layers behind the fighting. The first is the Yuan's general plan for the conquest of the Song: after Boyan entered Lin'an in the second month of 1276 and the Song court surrendered, the Yuan court turned its weapons against the one region still not pacified, Sichuan, and so the Western River Military Government set up its headquarters at Luzhou and took charge of the armies in the field, turning a Song stronghold into its own command post, which directly provoked the Song into a retaliatory blow. The second is the survival crisis of Song Sichuan: once Xiangfan had fallen, the shield of Jinghu and the Two Rivers was gone, the grain route and the channel of reinforcements for southern Sichuan narrowed to a single line along the river, and Chongqing and Hezhou became the last Song redoubts; Zhang Jue had to hold the line outside Chongqing, and the Yuan headquarters happened to be sitting at Luzhou. The third is the struggle for the initiative: Zhang Jue judged that rather than sit and be strangled at Chongqing, the better plan was to strike at the Luzhou headquarters, break the enemy's command centre and take its salt revenue, which would leave him room to manoeuvre; and once the June raid succeeded, Luzhou became the Yuan's target in turn. The fourth lies in geography and supplies: Luzhou stands where the Yangtze and the Tuo meet, commanding the water and land routes into southern Sichuan and lying on the road the Song river patrols and the upstream grain boats had to use, so neither side could leave it alone. The Yuan accordingly substituted blockade and starvation for a quick assault, stretching the siege out to more than a year.
impact: 此役的直接後果是宋元在川南的攻守易位。1277年11月瀘州陷落後，元軍取得長江上游的漕運樞紐與井鹽產區，四川的財政與糧源由是轉入元朝之手；元軍並以漢軍降卒、水師與攻城器械接管川南，使得此後收拾合州釣魚城與重慶的殘局有了兵源與舟師可用。對南宋而言，瀘州失守意味著張珏經營多年的川南防線被從中切斷，援軍再無順江東下的安全通道，宋廷最後的抵抗只能縮回合州釣魚城與重慶兩處山城，釣魚城一直撐到1279年南宋覆亡才最後易手。技術層面的教訓更具體：城頭的十字弩與神臂弓確實守得住——宋軍靠弩與寨堡拖住元軍一年有餘，幾次夜襲都把登城之敵趕下城頭；但弩手無法解決糧道問題，弩愈精確，守城愈依賴糧，糧一斷，弩手與牆垛一齊失去意義。元軍入川之後，瀘州由抗元前線變成元朝西南的財賦重鎮，井鹽重新編入官府收支，川南鹽井的開採與官營體制皆由此定型，延續至明清。
impactEn: The immediate result of this campaign was a reversal of who held and who lost in southern Sichuan. With Luzhou fallen in November 1277, the Yuan took the hinge of the upper-river transport system and the salt district of the region, and the finances and grain of Sichuan passed into Yuan hands; the Yuan also took over the south of the province with Han Chinese surrendered troops, river troops and siege equipment, so that the mopping-up of Hezhou's Diaoyucheng and Chongqing afterwards had troops and boats to draw on. For the Southern Song, the loss of Luzhou meant that the southern Sichuan defence line Zhang Jue had laboured over for years was cut in half, and that reinforcements no longer had a safe route down the river: the Song court's last resistance shrank back to the two mountain fortresses of Hezhou and Chongqing, and Diaoyucheng held out until 1279, when the Song finally fell, before its last change of hands. The technical lesson is more concrete: the crossbow and the shenbi bow on the walls really did hold — the Song used crossbows and stockades to stretch the Yuan out for more than a year, and several night attacks threw the escalators back off the wall — but crossbowmen cannot solve the problem of the grain route; the more exact the crossbow, the more the defence depends on grain, and when the grain is cut the crossbowmen and the battlements are lost together. After the Yuan entered Sichuan, Luzhou changed from a forward position against the Song into a fiscal centre of the southwest; the salt wells were brought back under official accounting, and the working and official-control system of the southern Sichuan salt wells took its shape from here and continued into the Ming and Qing.
result: 結果是元軍攻下瀘州，宋軍全敗，但過程並非一面倒。德祐二年六月的開場是宋軍得手：張珏與瀘州義士劉霖、先坤朋奇襲西川行院治所，殺守將熊耳與安撫梅應春，俘虜元將眷屬，元軍一度失去設在宋地的指揮所。十月元軍撤圍重慶轉攻瀘州，戰局才逆轉：且只兒在合江紅米灣、安樂山連敗宋軍，奪石盤寨水寨，切斷漕舟與援軍；宋將史忠訓、趙安所率援軍被拜延阻擊，百餘人被俘，瀘州從此孤懸。景炎二年（1277）十一月總攻時，元軍先以步魯合答的雲梯取寶子寨、劉思敬取盤山寨、劉垓與拜延取珍珠堡，外圍三處寨堡盡失；宋軍再以弩手與城樓抵抗，擊退石抹不老一度衝上神臂門的攻勢，但一日激戰之後疲憊已極，劉思敬乘夜襲破東門，秃滿答兒與札剌不花夜奪水城，黎明各軍登城，天亮後共攻神臂門，萬戶也罕的斤與石抹不老先克，終於破城。王世昌、李都統戰歿，劉雄被俘，劉思敬破盤山寨時所擒的任慶與九千餘戶一併落入元軍之手。從器械角度看，這是一場「弩守得住城、守不住糧」的戰役：十字弩在城頭與寨堡裡撐起了一年有餘的抵抗，卻挽回不了糧道被切、外援被阻的困局；而元軍真正的武器不是任何攻城器，而是封鎖、耐心與攻城序列之間的配合。最後宋軍保住了合州與重慶，卻丟掉了瀘州，此後南宋在四川的抵抗退守一隅，終於1279年崖山覆亡。
resultEn: The Yuan took Luzhou and the Song army was defeated, though the course of the fighting was not one-sided. The opening in the sixth month of 1276 was a Song success: Zhang Jue and the Luzhou volunteers Liu Lin and Xian Kunpeng raided the Western River Military Government headquarters, killed the garrison commander Xiong'er and the pacification commissioner Mei Yingchun, and captured the families of Yuan officers, so that for a time the Yuan lost the command post it had standing in Song territory. In the tenth month the Yuan lifted the siege of Chongqing and turned on Luzhou, and the tide turned: Jie Zhi'er beat the Song twice near Hongmi Bay and Anle Mountain, took the water stockade of Shipanzhai, and cut off the grain boats and the relief column; the Song force of Shi Zhongxun and Zhao An was intercepted by Bayan and more than a hundred were taken, and Luzhou was left isolated. At the general assault of the eleventh month of 1277, the Yuan first took Baozhai with Buluheda's ladders, Panshanzhai with Liu Sijing, and Zhenzhupu with Liu Gai and Bayan, and the three outer stockades were lost one after another. The Song still resisted with crossbowmen on the towers, throwing back the assault of Shimo Buliao at the Shenbi Gate, but after a hard day's fighting the defenders were spent, Liu Sijing broke the East Gate by night, Tumandare and Jalabagha seized the water city by night, the troops climbed in at dawn, and once the sun rose all the units turned on the Shenbi Gate, taken first by Yahan Diken and Shimo Buliao; the city fell. Wang Shichang and Li Dutong were killed, Liu Xiong was taken prisoner, and Ren Qing — seized by Liu Sijing at Panshanzhai — together with more than nine thousand households, fell into the Yuan's hands. Seen from the point of view of the weapons, this was a battle in which the crossbow could hold the wall but not hold the grain: the crossbow on the walls and in the stockades sustained a resistance lasting more than a year, yet it could not make up for a cut grain route and a blocked relief; and the Yuan's true weapon was not any single siege engine but the combination of blockade, patience and the sequencing of the siege. In the end the Song kept Chongqing and Hezhou but lost Luzhou, and resistance in Sichuan thereafter contracted to a single corner, ending with the fall of Yamen in 1279.
